_doc: Course source registry — 8 free public catalogues for Phase 0 (CHITTI_NEWS_AI_MASTER_SPEC v0.3 §3 + §4). Per the rules-first doctrine: real sources, no AI-generated entries, classification is deterministic and explainable. Each source declares: (a) default_professions — base tags every item from this source inherits (e.g. fast.ai is software-developer by default), (b) url_patterns — additional tags emitted when an item's URL matches a substring or regex, (c) the standard transport (json/rss/static_manifest). The classifier combines these source-level signals with item-level keyword matches against profession_registry.json to produce explainable tags.
_classifier_contract: Source-default tags + URL patterns + item keyword hits → per-profession confidence score. No LLM in the critical path. Every emitted tag carries matched_keywords + source_signals for audit.
